title: In-game Trainer 0.4.0-beta.3 / 刷取与切图修复
body:
Fixes queued Joker spawning and panel events after travel.

- A burst of F3 input keeps at most one pending spawn request. Selecting another card cancels that request.
- Failed native spawn calls retain the two-second cooldown.
- Old-controller panel clicks are ignored after travel.
- All 31 offline Lua test files passed. The user confirmed F2/F4 mouse navigation and paging, a short F3 burst producing one pickup, pickup interaction, and use after returning to the saloon.

Download **FFWTrainer-0.4.0-beta.3.zip**, close the game, and copy the contents of GameRoot into the game folder. Keep Data/settings.json and fully restart. Requires a separate compatible UE4SS installation; baseline game 0.3.0.7 / UE4SS build 1181. Source ZIP and SHA-256 checksums are included.

修复卡顿时积压刷卡请求、失败调用绕过冷却，以及切图后旧按钮仍触发操作的问题。31 份离线测试通过；用户已确认 F2/F4 鼠标分类翻页、少量 F3 刷卡与拾取、返回酒馆后继续操作均正常。

更新时完全退出游戏，复制运行 ZIP 中 GameRoot 的内容，保留 Data/settings.json，再重新启动。附件仅包含修改器及所需依赖，不含个人数据、存档或日志。

The original reporter's native crash has not been independently reproduced; this remains a beta release. 原评论者的原生崩溃尚未独立复现。
